svg.aria-label: Code example: // From XwiftCore: resolved at compile time, once per target private static var currentOS: OperatingSystem { #if os(macOS) return .macOS #elseif os(iOS) return .iOS #elseif os(Android) return .android #elseif os(Linux) return .linux #elseif os(Windows) return .windows #elseif os(WASI) return .wasi #else return .unknown #endif }
